description: Source code implementation of UberReceivedPacketManager class for managing QUIC packet reception, acknowledgment, and packet number spaces support.

classes.name: UberReceivedPacketManager
classes.description: Manages received QUIC packets, acknowledgment frames, and supports multiple packet number spaces.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the packet manager from a given QUIC configuration and perspective.

methods.name: IsAwaitingPacket
methods.description: Checks if a specific packet is awaited in the current packet number space.

methods.name: GetUpdatedAckFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the latest acknowledgment frame for a given packet number space.

methods.name: RecordPacketReceived
methods.description: Records the reception of a packet with its header, receipt time, and ECN codepoint.

methods.name: DontWaitForPacketsBefore
methods.description: Sets the manager to not wait for packets before a certain packet number.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateAckTimeout
methods.description: Potentially updates the acknowledgment timeout based on recent packet reception.

methods.name: ResetAckStates
methods.description: Resets acknowledgment states for a given encryption level.

methods.name: EnableMultiplePacketNumberSpacesSupport
methods.description: Enables support for multiple packet number spaces, with checks to prevent re-enabling.

methods.name: IsAckFrameUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment frame has been updated.

methods.name: GetLargestObserved
methods.description: Returns the largest observed packet number for a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgment timeout for a specific packet number space.

methods.name: GetEarliestAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the earliest acknowledgment timeout across all packet number spaces.

methods.name: IsAckFrameEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment frame for a packet number space is empty.

methods.name: peer_least_packet_awaiting_ack
methods.description: Returns the least packet number awaiting acknowledgment, only valid when multiple spaces are not supported.

methods.name: min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of received packets before decimating ACKs.

methods.name: set_min_received_before_ack_decimation
methods.description: Sets the minimum received packets before ACK decimation.

methods.name: set_max_retransmittable_packets_before_ack
methods.description: Sets the maximum retransmittable packets before ACK (Cobalt customization).

methods.name: set_ack_frequency
methods.description: Sets the acknowledgment frequency.

methods.name: ack_frame
methods.description: Returns the current acknowledgment frame when multiple spaces are not supported.

methods.name: GetAckFrame
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgment frame for a specific packet number space.

methods.name: set_max_ack_ranges
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of acknowledgment ranges.

methods.name: set_save_timestamps
methods.description: Enables or disables timestamp saving for received packets.

methods.name: OnAckFrequencyFrame
methods.description: Handles an incoming acknowledgment frequency frame (Cobalt customization).
